class: Inline repeated-entry scoping and expansion failure on paragraph-titled sections
site: Coinbase (Greenhouse) and any employer form using paragraph/generic headers for repeated work and education
symptom: Coinbase application run 20261022_201348 filled only the first of three work history records, filled December 2022 into the current role's End date year, and failed to add the remaining jobs.
root_cause: repeated_entries._SECTION_WORK did not match bare 'Employment', and entry_map ignored text values on paragraph roles when discovering section titles, leaving repeated controls unmapped. Generic concept resolution then assigned EDUCATION_END_DATE to the job's End date year before Current role was evaluated. Furthermore, PageAgent lacked an inline entry expansion handler for forms without dedicated site adapters.
why_tests_missed: Existing repeated-entry tests used heading elements ('Work Experience 1') and Workday-style adapter fillers, never paragraph headers with inline 'Add another' DOM expansion.
fix: Extend _SECTION_WORK to match bare 'Employment', read section titles from paragraph and text roles, reset repeated section scope on separator elements, and implement PageAgent.add_missing_inline_entries to iteratively click inline Add buttons up to the candidate's history count with fail-safe blocker detection.
prevention: Map section boundaries from all structural roles including paragraph and separator before answering fields. Resolve current-job blank end dates within the scoped entry rather than falling through to global concept matching.
